## Problem and change

Describe the problem, the resulting behavior and any related issue.

## Validation

List the checks performed and their results. Distinguish automated checks, simulations, browser checks and actual NAS tests. For NAS tests, include plugin, Unraid and kernel versions.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and relevant documentation is updated.
- [ ] Checks relevant to the change pass, or limitations are explained above.
- [ ] If packaged inputs changed, the generated plugin and checksum are updated and package checks pass; otherwise this does not apply.
- [ ] Logs and screenshots contain no credentials or private information.
